frozen_before_calibration_output.definition: C = Delta ln(k_R_geo) / Delta ln(k_source), where k_R_geo is the geometric scale centroid of full response power R^2
frozen_before_calibration_output.reject_rule: reject common law before C7 if any eligible adjacent C3 or C5 C is non-finite or <=0
frozen_before_calibration_output.prospective_band_rule: if all slopes are positive, C7 band = [0.5*min(C), 2*max(C)]

interpretation: On the two pre-existing source-scale mechanisms C3 and C5, the full-response scale centroid co-moves with the mechanism-native source scale. This retrospective calibration only freezes a prospective band; it does not validate that band on a new family.
